acceptance_criteria: Any value that data(id).set accepts survives export and import unchanged, including a value at the maximum nesting depth; the depth limit is applied per data value in store, import and restore
An exportedAt value that is not a real calendar timestamp is rejected
cloneJson rejects objects with accessor properties, non-enumerable own properties and arrays with extra properties instead of dropping or evaluating them
restoreProfile validates its data argument itself; getActive never returns the id of a profile whose stored record is unreadable; a damaged entry with a malformed id segment can be removed
Display names are stored NFC-normalised and names with bidirectional or format control characters are rejected
An import larger than a documented limit on data names or total size is rejected without changing the store
docs/storage.md states that ProfileV1 carries a display name unlike the product contract section 3 shape, and that storing personal data awaits the caregiver decision of card NG-7
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Close the defects the NG-2 reviews found in src/profiles before anything stores real data: every export must be restorable, and input edge cases are rejected instead of altered
non_goals: The IndexedDB adapter, cross-tab coordination, export version 2, any user interface
